reason: I'd follow the page and take the free pack to see if my cat even touches it, but I wouldn't pay at the booth. RM 2.80 a pouch is no better than what I already get on Shopee during a sale with vouchers, and it's a brand I've never heard of.
objection: My cat is fussy. If she sniffs it and walks away, I've wasted money on a brand I can't return, and after the event I'd have to order by Facebook message with no vouchers, no reviews and no idea what delivery costs.
would_change_my_mind: If my cat finishes the free pack and I can then buy it on Shopee in a multipack that works out to about RM 2.20 a pouch or less, with reviews from other buyers.
